title: Extraction: emails to structured orders (output format)
description: Free text in, structured data out. Shows the answer format saving output tokens.
question: Extract every order from these emails: the customer name, the product (as named in our catalogue: Keyboard, Monitor 27", USB-C cable, Headset), the quantity and the delivery date as YYYY-MM-DD.

emails.subject: Order request #1
emails.body: Hi, please send 3 keyboards to our Kraków office. We need them by 4 November 2026. Thanks, Marta Nowak

emails.subject: Order request #2
emails.body: Hello — Jan Kowalski here. I'd like to order one 27-inch monitor (Monitor 27"), delivery on 2026-11-06 if possible.

emails.subject: Order request #3
emails.body: Order from Acme Sp. z o.o.: 25 × USB-C cable. Delivery: 3rd of November 2026. Invoice to the usual address.

emails.subject: Order request #4
emails.body: Could you ship two headsets for Ola Wiśniewska? Delivery date: Nov 10, 2026. Thank you!
